title: Novartis & Arist Dinner: The Great AI Reinvention in Pharma
summary: An off-the-record dinner discussing how AI is changing Talent, Learning and Enablement in the Pharmaceutical Industry
body_markdown: Join Novartis and Arist + an exclusive group of senior leaders in talent, enablement, HR and L&D, for an off-the-record conversation on the ways AI is changing how the world's leading pharmaceutical companies support, train, and enable their workforce.
